note: The solution labels a PO Spec may claim, each with the capability a use case must exercise for the claim to hold. `find` only locates the claim (English and Spanish) — the judge decides, per use case, whether the capability is exercised. A label no use case exercises is a mismatch: drop the label, or add the use cases that need it. Generic by construction: a label here is a kind of solution, never a product or a project's own word. Extend the list when a new kind of claim appears; never add an organization's vocabulary.

labels.name: Agentic / AI agents
labels.capability: the system itself pursues a goal by planning several steps and acting on other systems through tools — calling their APIs, updating records, sending transactions — without a person approving each step. Answering questions or holding a conversation is not it; neither is a fixed workflow a person triggers step by step.

labels.name: AI-powered / machine learning
labels.find: \bAI[- ]powered\b|\bartificial intelligence\b|\bmachine learning\b|\bML models?\b|\binteligencia artificial\b|\baprendizaje autom[áa]tico\b|\bmodelos? predictivos?\b|\bpredictive models?\b|\bcon IA\b|\bimpulsad[oa] por IA\b
labels.capability: a decision or an output in the flow is produced by a model learned from data — a prediction, a classification, a recommendation, generated text — rather than by fixed rules a person wrote.

labels.name: Real-time
labels.capability: a result reaches its user within seconds of the event that produced it, with no batch, scheduled or overnight step in between.

labels.name: Omnichannel
labels.capability: the same journey can be started in one channel and continued or completed in another, with at least two channels named in the use case.

labels.name: Self-service
labels.capability: the end user completes the whole journey without any staff member acting in it.

labels.name: Personalized
labels.capability: what the system shows or does differs per user, based on that user's own data or behaviour.

labels.name: Fully automated / straight-through
labels.find: \bfully automated\b|\bend[- ]to[- ]end automation\b|\bstraight[- ]through\b|\bzero[- ]touch\b|\btotalmente automatizad[oa]s?\b|\bsin intervenci[óo]n (?:humana|manual)\b|\bautomatizaci[óo]n (?:total|de punta a punta)\b
labels.capability: the process runs from its trigger to its outcome with no manual step by staff.

labels.name: Offline-capable
labels.capability: the user can complete the journey while the device has no network connection, and the result is reconciled when the connection returns.
